sources.notes: MapList.dat CP949; launch indices are order filtered by age and mode.
Character indices mapped by native function 0x41f9a0 (age/camp/index; 10 each). Korean names transcribed from shipped charInfo BMPs. Portrait aliases follow native photo table order.

Item IDs and image names decoded from 0x486390 HUD constructor, stack ID/name arrays at0x78/0x83c past and0x48/0xbc future. Korean weapon names use native kill-message strings0x537a00..0x537cd0 and shipped item art. Categories describe weapon type.
Secondary research cross-check only; character names vary by version. Catalog names/art taken from shipped version290 instead.

limitations: Catalog mappings are static; parent launcher verifies selected runtime combinations. No internet thumbnails downloaded; all pictures are original shipped game assets.

loadout.notes: Future first slot is not written by the offline setup branch. None is an unknown/unset field, not a weapon ID. Slot restrictions and replacement behavior require runtime validation.
